title: Illustration / Floating accents
slide_intent: Use separation purposefully because detached parts can aid posing but can also weaken a figure’s coherence.
strategic_value: Floating details derived from Duo’s feet can connect objects and characters to a recognizable Duolingo convention.
demonstration: Five isolated examples show floating feet, leaves, hat details, ears and hair above two rejected character treatments.
practical_value: Detach a part only when it serves the illustration or makes posing easier.

content_islands.name: Useful separations
content_islands.spec: Arrange Duo, carrot and three heads across the upper part of the pale panel.

content_islands.name: Forced separations
content_islands.spec: Place the two crossed-out full figures below.

content_islands.name: Purpose and limit
content_islands.spec: Explain the origin in Duo’s feet and the conditional use of floating objects at right.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source says floating parts give flexibility when turning and posing an object.
reference_purposes.Application: Examples extend the device from Duo’s feet to plants and heads.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Float an object only when it serves the illustration; do not force the device.

ingredient.name: Floating accents
ingredient.role: Allow flexible posing while repeating a recognizable construction device.
ingredient.application: Separate selected parts above or below a subject when the separation serves the drawing.
ingredient.scope: Occasional historical illustration device, not a requirement for every object or limb.
